title: micropus erectus var. multicaulis
intro: Micropus erectus var. multicaulis, commonly known as Multiflower, is a flowering plant in the dandelion family. This plant is used for its medicinal and edible properties, providing several health benefits such as supporting digestive health and relieving symptoms of anxiety and insomnia. The therapeutic actions of Multiflower include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its potential in treating various health issues. The bioactive constituents of Multiflower include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal and therapeutic effects.
